mechanism_narrative: PARKS improved from -29.1 to -16.1 across the four weekly means, the largest gain in any category and a sign that out-of-home activity is normalizing. This normalization broadens into discretionary errands within four weeks, lifting RETAIL_REC above its last-28-day mean.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS rose 13.0 points from t-3w (-29.1) to t-0w (-16.1)
failure_condition: PARKS remains at or above -20.0 at t-1w and t-0w, yet the mean of RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is less than or equal to its last-28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT is the most suppressed series at -70.1 but has improved 0.9 points over four weekly means. A crossing to -70.0 confirms that trip-making capacity is returning; transit-linked discretionary trips then pull RETAIL_REC above its prior 14-day mean within two weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT weekly mean rises to -70.0 or above
failure_condition: TRANSIT crosses -70.0 in the next two weekly means while the mean of RETAIL_REC over the following 14 days is below its prior 14-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: RESIDENTIAL held between 19.7 and 20.3 for four consecutive weekly means, roughly 20 points above baseline, while RETAIL_REC stayed near -41. As long as staying at home remains this elevated, a large share of consumption stays in the home and RETAIL_REC cannot exceed its last-28-day mean.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL weekly mean stays at or above 19.5 for two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL stayed in the 19.7-20.3 band across all four weeks
regime_hint: sustained at-home regime with restrictions in force
failure_condition: RESIDENTIAL stays at or above 19.5 for two more weekly means while the mean of RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days rises above its prior 14-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: WORKPLACES failed to recover (-38.7 at t-3w to -39.4 at t-0w) while TRANSIT sits at -70.1. The joint absence of office occupancy and transit traffic removes the weekday footfall that supports stores, so RETAIL_REC stays at or below its last-28-day mean over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES worsened 0.7 points from t-1w (-37.6) to t-0w (-39.4) while TRANSIT remained near -70
failure_condition: The mean of RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days exceeds its last-28-day mean while WORKPLACES stays below -38 and TRANSIT stays below -70.

mechanism_narrative: In a tightening-restrictions regime, a fresh policy shock surfaces first as a weekly drop in TRANSIT and WORKPLACES. That drop removes discretionary trips within two weeks, pushing RETAIL_REC below its prior 14-day mean before any recovery resumes.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT weekly mean falls more than 1.5 points versus the prior week, or WORKPLACES falls more than 2.0 points versus the prior week
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES fell 1.8 points from t-1w (-37.6) to t-0w (-39.4)
failure_condition: Following a weekly TRANSIT drop greater than 1.5 points, the mean of RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days is equal to or above its prior 14-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM sits only 7-9 points below baseline, showing essential errand trips continue, while RESIDENTIAL eased from 20.3 to 20.1. Together these indicate households are re-expanding errand circuits, which lifts RETAIL_REC above its last 7-day mean within one week.
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM ranged only between -8.7 and -7.3 across four weekly means
failure_condition: The mean of RETAIL_REC over the next 7 days is below its last 7-day mean while GROCERY_PHARM stays above -9.0 and RESIDENTIAL stays above 19.5.

mechanism_narrative: The PARKS gain from -29.1 to -16.1 is largely a seasonal outdoor-weather shift rather than a broad reopening. Seasonal outdoor spending substitutes for, and does not restore, enclosed retail, so RETAIL_REC stays below its last-28-day mean over the next four weeks even while PARKS keeps improving.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS gained 13.0 points while RETAIL_REC moved only from -41.9 to -43.1
regime_hint: seasonal outdoor transition with indoor capacity limits
failure_condition: PARKS exceeds -15.0 in a weekly mean and the mean of RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is above its last-28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: RETAIL_REC printed -43.1 at t-0w, its weakest of the four weekly means, while no other series shows a compensating surge. Short-horizon momentum therefore carries RETAIL_REC lower over the next week relative to the last week before any stabilization.
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC fell from -40.9 at t-1w to -43.1 at t-0w, its lowest reading
failure_condition: The mean of RETAIL_REC over the next 7 days is above -43.1, exceeding the t-0w weekly mean.
